Quality Assurance

ISO 9001 & CE Certified. Every product undergoes rigorous quality inspection from raw materials to finished goods.

Certifications

ISO 9001:2015

International quality management system certification, ensuring consistent product quality and continuous improvement.

CE Certified

European conformity marking, meeting EU safety, health and environmental protection standards.

Test Reports

Third-party lab testing reports available for all products, including performance and safety testing.

Industry Standards

Compliance with international industry standards including IEC, ANSI, and GB for power tools.

Quality Control Process

01

Raw Material Inspection

All incoming raw materials are tested for quality, durability and compliance before entering production. Non-conforming materials are rejected immediately.

02

Production Monitoring

Real-time quality monitoring during every stage of production. Trained QC inspectors perform random sampling tests on the assembly line.

03

Finished Product Testing

Every finished product undergoes comprehensive performance testing including power output, torque, battery life, and safety checks.

04

Pre-Shipment Inspection

AQL (Acceptable Quality Level) sampling inspection before shipment. Full inspection reports and photos provided to clients.

05

After-Sales Tracking

Continuous quality tracking after delivery. Customer feedback is collected and analyzed to drive product improvement.
